title: Dead local EndGrid in APPRunGameMode::EndDraw — computed every drag, never read
evidence:
Source/PacketPlumber/PPRunGameMode.cpp:171:		const PP::FIntPoint EndGrid = MakeScreenFit(ViewportSize).ScreenToGrid(ScreenPos);

grep -n EndGrid Source/PacketPlumber/PPRunGameMode.cpp → exactly one hit (line 171, the declaration); the following block uses FPPCommandBus::SnapToNode(SimState.Topology, DragStartScreen/ScreenPos, ViewportSize, ...) and never references EndGrid. The r2 commit removed the sibling leftovers ("DragStartGrid + bHasLastEditError removed") but missed this one.
detail: Leftover from the r1 grid-quantized snap path; the r2 snap is screen-space, so this is a dead store on every drag-end and unused-variable warning noise.
recommended_fix: Delete the EndGrid declaration line (and the bare block braces it motivated) in EndDraw.

title: Orphan helper: PPViewGeometry::RoadFillHeight has zero callers
evidence:
Source/PacketPlumber/Public/PPViewGeometry.h:41:inline float RoadFillHeight(float Width)

RoadCasingHeight (line 46) is called by Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/PPViewGeometryTests.cpp:48 ("const float CasingH = PPViewGeometry::RoadCasingHeight(Width, 2.f);"), but grep -rn RoadFillHeight across Source/, tests/, scripts/ returns only the definition line — no caller anywhere (the view's fill height is implicit in MakeRoad's SetSize).
detail: Dead public helper shipped in the r2 geometry-extraction header; nothing can pin it because nothing executes it.
recommended_fix: Delete RoadFillHeight, or make MakeRoad's fill sizing use it.

title: MakeRoad hardcodes casing height (Width + 4.0f, three sites) instead of the tested RoadCasingHeight helper
detail: The tested helper and the shipped renderer express the same formula independently; a future casing-thickness change in the helper won't reach the renderer — exactly the math-drift class the r2 road-anchor blocker came from.
recommended_fix: Add kCasingThickness = 2.0f and derive the casing ribbon width + slot height from RoadCasingHeight(Width, kCasingThickness).

title: PPViewGeometry.h contract comment names a nonexistent test and overclaims "the view calls these"
evidence:
Source/PacketPlumber/Public/PPViewGeometry.h:7:// position. The view calls these; the PacketPlumber.View.Geometry test
Source/PacketPlumber/Public/PPViewGeometry.h:8:// pins them — a regression in any of the r2 geometry bugs (road anchor,

Actual IMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_AUTOMATION_TEST names in Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/PPViewGeometryTests.cpp: "PacketPlumber.View.RoadAnchor" (line 22), "PacketPlumber.View.DotOnRoad" (line 65), "PacketPlumber.View.SnapRadiusScale" (line 114) — no test named PacketPlumber.View.Geometry exists anywhere.
detail: The header's coverage claim points at a test that doesn't exist under that name, and RoadFillHeight/RoadCasingHeight aren't called by the view at all — misleading for the next maintainer.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to name the three actual tests and scope the view-usage claim to RoadSlotTopLeft/EaseInOut/PacketGridPos (or add the umbrella test).
